messages:
Nate P: heads up 73 opened PR #4728 to update SOC2-compliant wording for the 'Audit export' guide. Legal flagged 'we store indefinitely' and examples that show plain emails and epoch-ms. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4728 Can @Priya (legal) + @Lina D sanity-check the snippets?

docs-bot: PR 4728 build passed: preview https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4728 :white_check_mark:

Priya (legal): prefer 'retention period' + explicitly list defaults. redact examples to pseudonyms. add a sentence: 'Customers retaining exported logs must ensure they comply with applicable laws and internal policies.'

Ezra M: for migration, we already changed export ts format from epoch-ms to RFC3339 last April. recommend adding tiny parse examples for Python and Go and a jq example to strip PII: 
```bash
# jq strip emails and convert
curl -s https://export.example/123 | jq 'map(.email=null)'
```
```py
from datetime import datetime
parsed = datetime.fromisoformat('2024-05-01T12:34:56+00:00')
```
```go
import "time"
t, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, ts)
```

Lina D: I'll replace sample rows with pseudonymized data and add a 'migration note: timestamp format' page and fix anchor links. Also include a small redaction helper in Python and a one-liner in bash.

Nate P: Proposed root sentence: 'By default, audit exports redact personal identifiers; customers may configure retention periods according to their plan. Contact support for extended retention or legal holds.'

Priya (legal): tweak to 'personal identifiers (e.g., email, phone)'. Also add 'Customers are responsible for downstream retention and must comply with applicable laws.'

Lina D: pushing commit with pseudonymized snippet + jq, py, go examples + migration page and index anchor fix. tagging @Priya and @Nate for final approval.

Nate P: Great. Quick merge checklist: 1) wording updated, 2) snippets pseudonymized, 3) migration page created, 4) anchor fixed, 5) preview ok. I'll merge after approvals. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: commit a4f7d9c pushed - preview updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4728 :rocket:
